_readme: Known-correct solutions for every `sql` exercise, used ONLY by frontend/scripts/verify-sql-exercises.mjs. Never loaded by seed.py and never served to the browser (ExerciseOut returns data verbatim, so a solution placed inside the course JSON would be readable in devtools). Key: <course-slug>/<lesson-slug>/<exercise index within that lesson>. Run `npm run verify:sql` in frontend/ after adding an sql exercise — a missing key is a failure, not a skip.
postgresql/index-types-in-postgres/2: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_pending ON jobs (created_at) WHERE status = 'pending';
postgresql/window-functions-basics/0: CREATE VIEW top_sale_per_region AS SELECT region, amount FROM (SELECT region, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM sales) t WHERE rn = 1;
postgresql/window-functions-basics/1: CREATE VIEW ranked_scores AS SELECT player, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rk, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS dr FROM scores;
postgresql/window-frames-and-lag-lead/0: CREATE VIEW running_sales AS SELECT region, month, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running FROM sales;
postgresql/window-frames-and-lag-lead/1: CREATE VIEW sales_delta AS SELECT region, month, amount - LAG(amount, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS delta FROM sales;
postgresql/composite-indexes/0: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_created ON orders (customer_id, created_at);
postgresql/transactions-and-acid/0: BEGIN; UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance - 30 WHERE owner = 'alice'; UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 30 WHERE owner = 'bob'; COMMIT;
postgresql/altering-tables-safely/0: ALTER TABLE employees ADD COLUMN department TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general';
postgresql/joins-and-aggregations/0: CREATE VIEW top_customers AS SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.amount) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name;
